svg.title: MediaLog — Extra chapter symbol
svg.desc: A hardback drawn only in round orange plasma dots: bright edges round a dim cover with a hinge line and a bright award star, its page block peeking out, a notched ribbon and a sparkle beside the corner. Primary brand colour #18223a, plain MediaLog wordmark. The backbox display’s grid of round dots and stepped brightness draw a book, with dark gaps instead of a panel; A star on the cover and a sparkle are the award frame; no score digits or lettering.
